risk_note: RV2 (agent + specs/agent-tools.allowlist; planning/05 B3-16, D32; D10-1225 / 1234 / 1239 / 1240 / 1242). get_my_earnings: no-parameter tool in the allowlist, offered only to a phone-bound subject and behind agent.tools.get_my_earnings.enabled; the agent module imports nothing of ledger / payout and hands no database handle out ([AC-B3-08k#1], depcruise); the composition root's apps/api/src/agent-earnings-reads.ts reads only through the named read-only exports ledger/read.ts getWalletSummary and payout/read.ts listWithdrawalsForUser, both in one read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction per call, and app.module hands the stream entry that handle-free earningsReads (D10-1244) (no cache across calls; any failure is reported as unavailable, no card); earnings_summary card figures equal GET /v1/wallet/summary field by field, the withdrawal carries only its main status title and applied amount; the model gets only the card reference, the text is replaced with agent.earnings.summary and fallback_text is agent.earnings.fallback; agent_cards / trace / history keep no amounts. The production assembly always registers the tool; without the wallet port it answers unavailable. app.module.ts (D10-1240 / D10-1244, composition root only): the stream entry gets earningsReads and registers the withdrawal decrypt port the payout read needs. Frozen tests (D10-1234 / D10-1239): the registered / allowlist set goes from 7 to 8 tools by changing the kits stream-assembly-orders/scan.ts (EXPECTED_TOOLS, NEVER_OFFERED) and kit.ts (switch seeds, D10-1242 ①) and rule-search-wiring/kit.ts (TOOLS), plus one assertion list in allowlist.test.ts (modify_existing); every test title is left as on main (FU-MODIFY-EXISTING-RETITLE will update them), the four unchanged B3-08l cases cascaded by the kit change are red_exempt (D10-752). The kits are class-1 test-support files, released by the owner label (#24). The brief was written by hand: the ten refs total 109 KB (main-table rows and the BR-AI-01 decision-order detail excerpted). Host: guard (test-guard, path / protected) and depcruise 0, tsc 0, eslint / prettier 0, depcruise 0, agent unit tests 457, every non-integration rule test under test/spec/agent 2952 (incl. foreign-db-handoff), integration 22 files / 82 tests (earnings-tool and the frozen stream-assembly-orders / rule-search-wiring / trace-persist / core-reply-templates suites, container slot); full verification is the required CI checks (approvals #21). Follow-up B3-16c (D10-1242 ②): a per-user cache kill case in figures.int.test.ts.
